text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small pieces of code, while integration tests make sure different parts of a system work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Although writing tests takes extra time, it brings real benefits. Tests catch problems early, so fixing them is cheaper and easier. Most importantly, good tests give developers confidence. When they change or improve their code, they know quickly if something breaks. This confidence allows teams to work faster and release better software.
